newsitem.title: CONGO: Police disperse Congo students with teargas.
newsitem.headline: Police disperse Congo students with teargas.

text.p: Police dispersed protesting students with teargas in Congo's capital Brazzaville on Friday after they gathered in the arts faculty to demand that the government pay grant arrears, witnesses said.
Police detained a handful of students on suspicion of organising the demonstration and deployed around the university to prevent further protests.
President Pascal Lissouba, who faces presidential elections in July, met student representatives on Thursday to discuss their grievances. The arrears date back over a year.
Brazzaville's Marien Ngouabi University has 20,000 students. Classes were suspended pending a return to normal.
